title: Video Library
head: Curated videos about disappearing languages. Click a card to watch.

videos.title: Documentary: Languages Lost and Remembered
videos.description: A broad, accessible documentary tracing the causes of language loss — migration, assimilation, and globalization — with interviews and archival recordings.

videos.title: Case Study: A Language's Final Speakers
videos.description: An intimate case study following the last speakers of a threatened language, showing cultural impact and personal stories.

videos.title: Revival & Documentation Efforts
videos.description: Focuses on linguists, communities, and grassroots projects working to document, archive, and revive endangered languages.
